info.title: Tempo API
info.description: HTTP API for Tempo, a self-hosted running tracker. Protected routes accept `Authorization: Bearer` with either a JWT (interactive web session) or an admin-issued API key (prefix `tmp_`). Machine clients (CLI, automation) typically use API keys; JWTs are usually issued via cookie after login.

post.description: Creates a new user account. Registration is only available if no users exist in the system.
Authenticates user and returns JWT token in httpOnly cookie.

get.summary: Get current user info (JWT session or API key).
get.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user. Accepts JWT (cookie or Bearer) or API key (Bearer, prefix tmp_).

get.summary: Check if registration is available (no users exist)
get.description: Returns whether registration is available (true if no users exist).

post.description: Creates an API key for machine/CLI access. The full key is returned once; store it securely. Requires a browser JWT session (not an API key).

get.summary: List API keys
get.description: Returns metadata for your API keys (never the secret value).

delete.description: Soft-revokes an API key so it no longer authenticates.

get.summary: Get heart rate zones configuration
get.description:
Returns the current heart rate zones configuration. If no settings exist, returns default zones
calculated using age-based method with age 30 (max HR = 190).

put.description:
Updates heart rate zones using one of three calculation methods:
- AgeBased: Requires age, calculates max HR as 220 - age
- Karvonen: Requires max HR and resting HR
- Custom: Requires exactly 5 zones with valid boundaries

post.summary: Update heart rate zones and optionally recalculate relative effort
post.description:
Updates heart rate zones and optionally recalculates relative effort for all qualifying workouts
in one atomic operation. If RecalculateExisting is true, all workouts with heart rate data will
have their relative effort recalculated using the new zones.

requestBody.description: Heart rate zones update request with optional recalculation flag

get.summary: Get unit preference
get.description: Returns the stored unit preference. Defaults to "metric" if no preference has been set.

put.description:
Updates the unit preference to either "metric" or "imperial". This affects how distances
and splits are calculated and displayed throughout the application.

get.summary: Get default shoe
get.description: Returns the current default shoe, or null if none is set

put.description: Sets the default shoe for automatic assignment to new workouts. Pass null to clear the default.

get.summary: List all shoes with calculated mileage
get.description: Returns all shoes with calculated total mileage based on assigned workouts

post.description: Creates a new shoe with brand, model, and optional initial mileage

patch.description: Updates shoe brand, model, and/or initial mileage

delete.description:
When a shoe is deleted, all assigned workouts' ShoeId is set to null (handled by database cascade).
If the shoe is set as the default shoe, the default shoe is also cleared.

get.summary: Get calculated total mileage for a shoe
get.description: Returns the total calculated mileage for a shoe in user's preferred units

get.summary: Get weekly stats
get.description:
Returns daily miles for the current week (Monday-Sunday), grouped by day of week.
Distances are converted from meters to miles. Week boundaries are calculated in the specified timezone.

parameters.name: timezoneOffsetMinutes
parameters.description: Timezone offset in minutes (negative for timezones behind UTC)

get.summary: Get relative effort stats
get.description:
Returns cumulative relative effort for the current week (Monday-Sunday) and calculates
the 3-week average and range from the previous 3 complete weeks.

parameters.name: timezoneOffsetMinutes
parameters.description: Timezone offset in minutes (negative for timezones behind UTC)

get.summary: Get best efforts for all standard distances
get.description:
Returns the fastest time achieved for each standard running distance (400m through Marathon).
Best efforts are calculated from any segment within any workout, not just workouts of that exact distance.

post.description:
Performs a full recalculation of all best efforts across all workouts.
This may take some time depending on the number of workouts and time series data.

get.summary: Get yearly stats
get.description:
Returns total miles for the current year and previous year. Year boundaries are calculated
in the specified timezone. Distances are converted from meters to miles.

parameters.name: timezoneOffsetMinutes
parameters.description: Timezone offset in minutes (negative for timezones behind UTC)

get.summary: Get yearly weekly stats
get.description:
Returns 52 equal week buckets within a 1-year period, covering all dates with no gaps or overlaps.
If periodEndDate not provided, defaults to today (last 12 months ending today).
Each bucket represents approximately 1/52 of the total period.

parameters.name: periodEndDate
parameters.description: End date of the period (YYYY-MM-DD format). If not provided, defaults to today.

parameters.name: timezoneOffsetMinutes
parameters.description: Timezone offset in minutes (negative for timezones behind UTC)

get.summary: Get available periods
get.description:
Returns consecutive 1-year periods (365/366 days) going backwards from today.
Current period is the last 12 months ending today. Stops when reaching the first workout date
or after 20 periods (safety limit).

parameters.name: timezoneOffsetMinutes
parameters.description: Timezone offset in minutes (negative for timezones behind UTC)

get.summary: Get available years
get.description: Returns a list of distinct years (in descending order) that have workouts in the database.

get.summary: Get running insights including data coverage metadata
get.description:
Returns comprehensive insights about running data including weather extremes, performance highlights,
habit patterns, and data availability metadata. Requires at least 5 workouts to return insights.
Returns helpful messages when insufficient data exists.

get.summary: Get version information
get.description:
Version information is retrieved from environment variables (set during Docker build) or from the VERSION file.
Returns "unknown" for any values that cannot be determined.

post.description:
Uploads and processes one or more GPX or FIT files (.gpx, .fit, or .fit.gz), extracting workout data
and saving it to the database. Supports multiple files for batch import. Accepts optional unitPreference
form field (metric or imperial) to determine split calculation distance.

get.summary: List workouts with pagination and filtering
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of workouts with optional filtering by date range, distance, keyword search,
and run type. Supports dynamic sorting by various fields. Dates are normalized to UTC for database queries.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter workouts starting from this date (inclusive)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter workouts ending before this date (inclusive)

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search keyword (searches Name, Device, and Source fields)

parameters.name: runType
parameters.description: Filter by run type (e.g., "Race", "Workout", "Long Run", "Easy Run")

post.summary: Upload media files to a workout
post.description:
Uploads one or more media files (images/videos) to a workout. Files are validated for size and MIME type,
stored on the filesystem, and metadata is saved to the database. Returns error details if any files fail to upload.

get.summary: List all media files for a workout
get.description:
Retrieves all media files associated with a workout, ordered by creation date.
Returns metadata including filename, MIME type, file size, caption, and creation timestamp.

delete.summary: Delete a media file from a workout
delete.description:
Deletes a media file from a workout by removing the file from the filesystem and the database record.
Continues with database deletion even if file deletion fails (handles orphaned records).

get.summary: Get a specific media file for a workout
get.description:
Retrieves and serves a specific media file for a workout. Supports range requests for video seeking.
Returns the file with the appropriate MIME type and filename for download.

post.summary: Recalculate relative effort for a workout
post.description:
Recalculates the Relative Effort score for a workout using the current heart rate zone configuration.
Requires heart rate zones to be configured in settings first.

Recalculates splits for a workout using the current unit preference. Splits are calculated as
1km for metric or 1 mile for imperial. Requires the workout to have route data.

Crops/trims a workout by removing time from the beginning and/or end. Updates all derived data including
distance, duration, pace, splits, and relative effort. Requires the workout to have route data.

get.summary: Get similar routes for a workout
get.description:
Returns previous workouts that were completed on similar routes, allowing users to compare
their current performance with past efforts. Includes time and pace differences compared to
the current workout. Requires the workout to have route data.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

get.summary: Paginated heart-rate samples for a workout (from stored time series).
get.description: Returns paginated heart-rate samples from stored workout time series. Each item has elapsedSeconds (integer seconds from workout start) and heartRateBpm (integer). Samples are sparse: only timestamps where heart rate was recorded are included (not a dense sample for every second). GPX imports may be sparse; FIT files are often about one sample per second but not guaranteed. The server does not interpolate missing seconds; clients may interpolate if needed. Ordering is ascending by elapsedSeconds, then by row id when multiple samples share the same second. Default pageSize is 1000 with a maximum of 5000; use multiple requests for long activities.

get.summary: Get workout details
get.description:
Retrieves complete workout data including route (as GeoJSON), splits, weather information,
and raw GPX/FIT/Strava data. Weather humidity values are normalized for consistency.

patch.description:
Updates workout RunType, Notes, and/or Name. All fields are optional - only provided fields are updated.
RunType must be one of: "Race", "Workout", "Long Run", "Easy Run", or null.
Name must be 200 characters or less.

delete.description:
Deletes a workout and all associated data including route, splits, media files (from filesystem),
and database records. Continues with deletion even if individual file deletions fail.

post.description:
Uploads and processes a ZIP file containing Strava export (activities.csv + activity files),
importing all run activities with duplicate detection. Supports optional unitPreference form field.
Only "Run" activities are imported; others are skipped.

post.summary: Export all user data to a ZIP file
post.description:
Exports all user data including workouts, media files, shoes, settings, and best efforts
in a portable ZIP format that can be imported back into Tempo.

Uploads and processes a ZIP file containing a complete Tempo export, restoring all user data
including workouts, media files, settings, shoes, routes, splits, time series, and best efforts.
Duplicates are skipped by default. GUIDs and timestamps from the export are preserved.

get.summary: Get count of workouts eligible for relative effort recalculation
get.description:
Returns the number of workouts that have heart rate data (time series, raw FIT data, or average HR)
and are eligible for relative effort calculation.

post.summary: Recalculate relative effort for all qualifying workouts
post.description:
Recalculates relative effort for all workouts that have time series heart rate data using the
current heart rate zone configuration. Requires heart rate zones to be configured first.

get.summary: Get count of workouts eligible for split recalculation
get.description: Returns the number of workouts that have route data and can have splits recalculated.

post.description:
Recalculates splits for all workouts that have route data using the current unit preference.
Splits are calculated as 1km for metric or 1 mile for imperial.

CreateShoeRequest.description: Request model for creating a shoe

defaultShoeId.description: Shoe ID to set as default, or null to clear the default

SetDefaultShoeRequest.description: Request model for setting default shoe

restingHeartRateBpm.description: Resting heart rate in BPM (required for Karvonen method)

maxHeartRateBpm.description: Maximum heart rate in BPM (required for Karvonen method)

zones.description: Custom zones (required for Custom method, must contain exactly 5 zones)

UpdateHeartRateZonesRequest.description: Request model for updating heart rate zones

restingHeartRateBpm.description: Resting heart rate in BPM (required for Karvonen method)

maxHeartRateBpm.description: Maximum heart rate in BPM (required for Karvonen method)

zones.description: Custom zones (required for Custom method, must contain exactly 5 zones)

recalculateExisting.description: If true, recalculates relative effort for all qualifying workouts after updating zones

UpdateHeartRateZonesWithRecalcRequest.description: Request model for updating heart rate zones with optional recalculation

UpdateUnitPreferenceRequest.description: Request model for updating unit preference

Bearer.description: JWT from login (often delivered as httpOnly cookie `authToken`; Swagger may use a pasted token) or API key string starting with `tmp_`. API key management endpoints require a full JWT session (not an API key).
